Visible food: a small pile of kimchi (about 40-50 g) and about 9 dark olives (Kalamata type, roughly 4-5 g each, so about 40-45 g with pits).

The plate is a square plate of about 24 cm. The kimchi measures roughly 8 cm by 5 cm and is thin, so it is about 40 g at around 15-20 kcal per 100 g, or about 8 kcal. The olives are 9 at roughly 5 g each, about 45 g, at around 115-140 kcal per 100 g, or about 55 kcal. Since the pit weight is included, the edible olive is somewhat less, so I estimate about 50 kcal.

Total is about 85 g and about 60 kcal.
